theme: hybrid (marketing light theme, admin support dark/light)

rules: Always use explicit line-height: leading-none for headings, leading-relaxed for body.
Use #1E3A8A as the primary anchor for trust.
Use #F97316 for high-intent CTAs (Get Quote, Book Survey) to draw attention.
Use #10B981 for savings, ROI, and eco-friendly indicators.
Never use pure black or grey. Use Slate scale (slate-900, slate-50) for tinted neutrals.
CRITICAL: Do not use complete transparent background in header or dropdowns.
Apply glassmorphism to sticky header and floating action buttons.
Cards should have a 1px subtle border.

buttons.primary: bg-orange-500 hover:bg-orange-600 text-white font-semibold rounded-full px-6 py-3 transition-colors
buttons.secondary: bg-blue-900 hover:bg-blue-800 text-white font-semibold rounded-full px-6 py-3 transition-colors
buttons.outline: border-2 border-blue-900 text-blue-900 hover:bg-blue-50 rounded-full px-6 py-3 transition-colors

cards.bento_item: bg-white border border-slate-200 rounded-2xl p-6 sm:p-8 flex flex-col h-full hover:-translate-y-1 transition-transform duration-300
cards.stat_card: bg-white border border-slate-200 rounded-xl p-5 flex items-center justify-between

inputs.default: w-full border border-slate-300 rounded-lg px-4 py-3 focus:ring-2 focus:ring-blue-500 focus:border-transparent transition-all outline-none

spacing.container: container mx-auto px-4 sm:px-6 lg:px-8 max-w-7xl

sequence: 2. SVG Circle path drawn (framer-motion length animation, 1s)
3. Sun and 'SUN SWITCH' text fade and scale in inside the circle (0.5s)
4. Entire splash screen fades out or slides up, revealing the homepage (1s)
logo_splash.note: Only play on first load (use sessionStorage).

interactions.hover: Scale up icons slightly, shift cards up by 4px, brighten button colors.
interactions.scroll: Use framer-motion for staggered fade-up of bento cards and section titles on scroll.

hero_residential.description: Modern concrete house with solar vibe. Use for residential hero.

commercial_solar.description: Rows of solar panels for commercial/industrial section.

solar_battery.description: Battery units for Hybrid/Off-grid product category.

solar_panel_close.description: Worker installing solar panel. Good for trust/services.

rules: Hero image must have max overlay opacity bg-slate-900/50 to ensure text readability while keeping image visible.
Images should be responsive and use object-cover.

libraries_and_tools.icons: lucide-react (default for UI), react-icons (if brand logos like WhatsApp are needed)
libraries_and_tools.charts: recharts (for Admin Dashboard and Solar Calculator graphs)
libraries_and_tools.ui: shadcn/ui (Cards, Inputs, Dialogs, Tables, Select, Tabs, Accordion)

accessibility.contrast: Ensure all text meets WCAG AA standards (4.5:1 ratio).
accessibility.testing: All interactive elements MUST have data-testid attributes (e.g., data-testid='hero-cta-button', data-testid='contact-form-submit').

general: Build a Hybrid application: Public Marketing Website and Secure Admin Panel (/admin).
Ensure all code is written in JavaScript (.js/.jsx) as this project does not use TypeScript (.tsx). Use standard prop validation if necessary.
Marketing side must feel premium, modern, and trustworthy. Use generous spacing (py-20) and bento grid layouts.
Admin side must be data-dense, modular, and use a standard sidebar + header layout. Include stat cards, lead management table with pipeline status, and CRUD panels.
The logo should be represented as a blue circle with a clean white border/ring around it. Apply this styling via CSS to a custom SVG or logo component.
For the contact bar, make it a narrow sticky top header above the main nav on desktop.
Implement the Solar Calculator and EMI Calculator with interactive sliders and instant results.
Do NOT use HTML <input type='date'> or <select>, use shadcn components.
Use sonner for all toast notifications.
admin_panel: Dashboard: 4-6 Stat cards (Total Enquiries, Site Surveys, etc.), 2 Recharts (Enquiries over time, Lead statuses).
Lead Management Table: Searchable, filterable by Status (NEW, CONTACTED, SITE SURVEY, QUOTATION, CONFIRMED, INSTALLATION, COMPLETED, CANCELLED). Include a mock CSV export button.
Use clean, industrial dashboard patterns: white cards, slate borders, compact padding (p-4 or p-6).

universal_guidelines_for_main_agent: Do not converge toward generic 'AI slop' aesthetics. Use layered design elements, z-index hierarchy, and deep contrast.
Do not use dark colors as gradients.
Do not center-align the app container (.App { text-align: center; } is banned). Left-align paragraphs and dense content.
Never use AI assistant emojis (🤖🧠💭) for icons. Use clean Lucide icons.
Every interaction needs micro-animations (hover states, transitions). Exclude transforms from universal transitions (transition: all is banned).
Use glassmorphism (backdrop-blur-xl bg-white/80) correctly. Do NOT use completely transparent backgrounds for headers or overlays.
Prioritize reusing pre-existing shadcn/ui components before building from scratch.
Never use placeholder URLs (like via.placeholder.com). Use the provided image URLs or styled divs if images are missing.
All components should be written in JavaScript (.js/.jsx) avoiding any TypeScript specific syntax.
